caption: The drawing depicts a doll with a simple round, pale, beige-colored face, featuring minimal facial details such as black eyes, small nose, and thin lips. The doll is dressed in a long-sleeved, floor-length pink dress decorated with a fine dark line pattern across the fabric, giving it a textured appearance. The dress features a high neckline and a fitted bodice that flares out into a wide skirt. Along the edges of the dress—including the cuffs, the hem, and two vertical lines running from the waist downward—are thin white strips adorned with evenly spaced small red circles, bordered by thin dark lines. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or details, and the entire composition is centered on the single figure of the doll. At the bottom of the page, the name "William Frank" is faintly printed or written.
title: Gingham Doll
